_about: The known, downloadable model set — DATA, not C# literals. The Registrar seeds each as \Capability\Model\<id> (seed-if-absent, so a user/agent selection or a disk-discovered record survives reboots); ModelCatalog PROJECTS \Capability\Model\* as the one truth and auto-discovers sideloaded files. `enabled` marks the active selection (single-active invariant kept by ModelCatalog.Select). No model file or URL is a source literal (SS020).

name: Gemma 4 E2B (DPX)
note: runs through the in-proc DPX interpreter (VOM-native, no admission/OOM brokering) - not the LiteRT C-API path. Sideloaded only (no url - adb push into files/models/); greedy decode only, no configurable sampler yet. Keeps id 'e2b' - ModelManager.DefaultId is a hardcoded C# fallback constant matching this exact id string.
